persona: A lay maintainer working on one Nova page who asks Neva about what is on that page, in Indonesian or English.
grading: Same lay-user rubric as golden-set.json, plus: used the page (the open SQL, the selected object, the page's filters) without asking for it again; SQL meant for the editor arrives there as a suggested change and nothing runs; the answer says where it came from.

facts.open_sql_file: Monthly net sales for the current year from NOVA_RETAIL_FIELD.sales_orders (order_date, net_amount).
facts.sales_orders_columns: order_line_id, order_id, invoice_no, order_date, order_time, outlet_id, product_id, salesman_id, quantity, unit_price, discount_pct, gross_amount, discount_amount, net_amount, cost_amount, returned_qty, payment_method, status
facts.outlets_columns: outlet_id, outlet_name, channel, tier, region, city, district, latitude, longitude, depot_id, opened_date, status
facts.ontology: Released glossary with domains Penjualan, Persediaan, Operasional (retail_steward) and HR (hr_steward); all released concepts are INTERNAL.

tasks.editor_text:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS bulan,
    SUM(net_amount) AS total_penjualan
FROM default_catalog.NOVA_RETAIL_FIELD.sales_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE())
  AND order_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE()), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
ORDER BY bulan;
tasks.prompt: Jelaskan query di editor saya ini dalam satu atau dua kalimat.
tasks.expect: Explains the open SQL: net sales (net_amount) per month for the current year from sales_orders, ordered by month. Does not ask the person to paste it.
